name: Bathran's Hair
summary: Among the ruins of Bathran's Haunt in northwestern Ashenvale, Bathran's Hair remains a rare herb. Night elf healers value its power against afflictions of the flesh and spirit.

sections.title: A Remedy for the Spirit
sections.body: Bathran's Hair grows among the ancient ruins north of Maestra's Post, where night elf healers have long valued it. Common herbs soothe wounds of the body, but Bathran's Hair is said to restore the spirit as well. When a young night elf in Astranaar falls gravely ill, herbalist Orendil Broadleaf seeks the rare plant to prepare a remedy.

sections.title: Gathering Amid the Ruins
sections.body: Bathran's Hair is harder to find among the ruins. It lies in discarded plant bundles and beneath leaf piles scattered across Bathran's Haunt, near the border of Darkshore. Forsaken have also been seen among the ruins, news that troubles Orendil Broadleaf.

faq.q: What is Bathran's Hair used for?
faq.answer: Night elf healers use Bathran's Hair against grave afflictions beyond ordinary sickness. Orendil Broadleaf combines it into a curative draft for a dying child whose spirit is wasting away.
Bathran's Hair grows within Bathran's Haunt, an ancient ruined settlement in northern Ashenvale, east of the main road leading north into Darkshore.

faq.q: Why are the Forsaken interested in Bathran's Haunt?
aliases: why are undead at bathrans haunt
faq.answer: Orendil Broadleaf learns that Forsaken are at Bathran's Haunt and finds their presence troubling, but what they want there is not explained. Elsewhere in Ashenvale, night elves report Forsaken at ruins and barrows, and fear they mean to spread disease across the forest.
Orendil Broadleaf is an herbalist at Maestra's Post in western Ashenvale. He studies local plants and prepares medicines for travelers and wounded defenders of the forest.

angles.text: Trained herbalists can find Bathran's Hair more readily, sensing hidden plant bundles among the debris with a practiced eye for wild flora.
For the Kaldorei, Forsaken among the ruins where healing plants like Bathran's Hair grow trouble the preservation of their ancient homeland.
